title: Townsend Brown's electrogravitics experiments in the late 1920s

tellings.quote: Okay. So late 1920s they were using very high voltage material uh resonant frequencies certain frequencies at very high voltage but low power.

plain: In the late 1920s, the American inventor Thomas Townsend Brown was experimenting with electrogravitics, the idea that strong electric fields can push against gravity, using very high voltage at low power and tuned to certain resonant frequencies, according to Steven Greer, a former doctor who leads a campaign to make UFO secrets public. Greer, drawing on the Disclosure Project Intelligence Archive, his group's collection of documents and testimony, tells Michels: "late 1920s they were using very high voltage material, resonant frequencies, certain frequencies at very high voltage but low power." If true, it would mean work on anti-gravity began in the United States and Germany decades before the modern UFO era.
